title: Argus-C2 locally trusted Ed25519 task envelope v2
$comment: At most 16384 bytes. Signature input is UTF-8 argus-c2/task/v2 followed by NUL, trust_set_id, NUL, key_id, NUL, and exact decoded payload bytes. IDs only select locally installed trust. Canonical unpadded Base64URL, fixed-domain Ed25519 verification, strict task-v1 payload validation, key time windows, local policy and durable replay checks are also mandatory. No public key or URL can be supplied by this envelope.
